question: What request is made to Śambhu regarding the complete disclosure of this secret teaching?
premises: The entirety of the teaching is referred to.
Śambhu is addressed with reverent epithets.
A request is made that all of it be told.
inference: The listener requests Śambhu, the compassionate great lord, to disclose the entire teaching.
plain_english: Let all of that be told, O Śambhu, O great lord, O ocean of compassion.
